summary: Tested Stock Tracking + GST Tax Invoicing module (/aetherV2/erp/). 29 backend pytest cases run covering vendors, stock items, adjustments+PnL, GRN with photo uploads + discrepancy enforcement, GST tax invoices (intra/inter-state CGST/SGST/IGST split, PDF generation, payment, GSTR HSN summary, invoice-from-GRN flow), Aether reasoner ERP intents (stock value, outstanding invoices, damages/losses, GST collected), auth (401/403/unknown action), and dashboard KPI. Fixed 1 critical SQL bug (reserved word `lines`) — after fix, all 29 backend tests pass. Frontend SPA loads, all 6 hash routes work, mobile responsive with hamburger menu confirmed at 600px.

minor.issue: SQL used MariaDB reserved word `lines` as column alias causing 500 error. Testing agent fixed by backticking the alias in /app/aetherV2/erp/api/invoice.php (line ~286).

action_items: Verify the `lines` backtick fix in invoice.php (line ~286) is acceptable; alternative is renaming alias to `line_count`.
Optional: consider returning the persisted invoice payload (number + tax totals) directly from invoice_save to avoid a second GET round-trip on the client.
critical_code_review_comments: SQL injection-safe: all endpoints use PDO prepared statements. Good.
Auth + RBAC enforced consistently: editor role correctly blocked (403) on vendor_save / stock_save / invoice_save; unauthenticated returns 401.
GRN discrepancy gate works correctly: posting a GRN with damages/shortages without an evidence attachment is blocked with 400; succeeds once a photo is uploaded.
Intra-state vs inter-state tax split is correct: buyer state_code 19 (same as org WB-19) produces CGST+SGST; buyer 27 produces IGST only.
PDF generation works end-to-end: Content-Type=application/pdf, valid %PDF magic header.
Aether reasoner local rules fire correctly for stock value / outstanding invoices / damages / GST queries before LLM fallback — deep links to /aetherV2/erp/#... are embedded in responses.
Reserved-word `lines` SQL bug indicates need for a lint pass over column aliases (could also check `order`, `key`, etc.).

rca_of_the_issue: invoice_gst_summary returned HTTP 500 because the SQL `SELECT ... COUNT(*) AS lines ...` used `lines` — a reserved word in MariaDB (used in BACKUP/RESTORE syntax). MariaDB rejected the alias with a 42000 syntax error. Fix: wrap alias in backticks: `COUNT(*) AS \`lines\``. Verified by running the endpoint after the fix — now returns 200 with HSN-wise breakdown and B2B/B2C totals.
